Title: Razorpay Live Keys & Webhook Configuration
Description: Live credentials and webhook signing secret must be configured in Render dashboard before live payments can be accepted.
Business_Impact: Customers cannot complete live purchases if test keys remain active.
Required_Fix: Generate live keys in Razorpay dashboard and add webhook endpoint https://guru-dimonds.onrender.com/api/payments/webhook/razorpay with payment.captured and payment.failed events.
Testing_Requirement: Execute zero-value or live test authorization check without live charge.

Title: Production Startup Environment Assertions
Description: Backend uses fallback strings if critical environment variables are missing during boot.
Business_Impact: Weakens JWT token forgery resistance if JWT_SECRET is omitted in production hosting.
Required_Fix: Add startup assertions throwing error and terminating process if NODE_ENV is production and critical secrets are missing or default.
Testing_Requirement: Test startup with unset secrets in staging container.

Title: Uncompressed Static Asset Footprint
Description: Public directory contains 162 assets totaling 293.49 MB of raw uncompressed PNGs.
Business_Impact: High mobile data usage and slower Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) on mobile 4G networks.
Required_Fix: Generate WebP/AVIF siblings and implement responsive picture elements while preserving original PNGs.
Testing_Requirement: Visual layout regression test and Core Web Vitals audit.

Title: Reverse Proxy Client IP Trust
Description: Express app does not configure trust proxy causing req.ip to reflect the Render reverse proxy IP.
Business_Impact: Could cause in-memory rate limiter to share rate buckets across users sharing the proxy.
Testing_Requirement: Verify req.ip correctly extracts client IP from X-Forwarded-For header.

Title: In-Memory Rate Limiting Horizontal Scale
Description: Sliding-window rate limiter stores timestamps in a Node process Map which resets on restart and is not shared across horizontal instances.
Business_Impact: Potential rate limit bypass if traffic is load-balanced across multiple Render container replicas.
Required_Fix: Implement Redis or Upstash durable rate limiting when scaling beyond a single container instance.
Testing_Requirement: Load test rate limit enforcement across distributed replicas.
